def f(inputs: List[Tuple[int, int, List[Tuple[int, int, int]]]]):

The Prim's algorithm works by maintaining a priority queue of edges, where the edge with the smallest weight is always at the front of the queue. The algorithm starts from an arbitrary node (in this case, node 0) and adds all its edges to the priority queue. Then it repeatedly removes the edge with the smallest weight from the queue, adds the corresponding node to the MST, and adds all its edges to the queue. The algorithm continues until all nodes have been added to the MST. The total weight of the MST is the sum of the weights of the edges in the MST.
